spans.text: You MUST draw exclusively from the last ~N messages. Do not investigate further — no grepping source files, no reading application code, no verifying claims.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the agent not to verify or investigate claims from the conversation. It must persist memories drawn exclusively from recent messages without verifying their accuracy, which undermines information integrity by potentially storing fabricated or incorrect information as fact.

spans.text: Examine the most recent ~N messages in the conversation and persist useful memories to the designated memory directory.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the agent to extract and persist user preferences and behavioral patterns without any mention of user consent, transparency about data retention, or restrictions on storing PII or sensitive data. The 'forget' mechanism exists but only when explicitly requested by the user, and there is no proactive privacy protection. The instruction to capture 'user preferences' broadly could include sensitive personal information.

spans.text: Available tools: Read, Grep, Glob, read-only Bash, and Edit/Write restricted to the memory directory only. The `rm` command is not permitted.
spans.note: The prompt enforces least privilege and restricts tool access. Write/Edit operations are restricted to the memory directory only, the rm command is explicitly prohibited, and Bash access is read-only. This demonstrates good tool safety practices.
